recipe.title: Quarterly dependency, licence and security audit across every workspace crate
recipe.description: Walks every crate in the workspace, resolves the full transitive dependency graph, flags anything with a published advisory or a licence outside the approved set, and writes the findings up as a single markdown report with one section per crate and a short remediation note against each finding.
recipe.instructions: Work crate by crate in workspace order. For each one run `cargo tree -e normal`, then `cargo audit --json`, then read the licence field of every direct dependency. Do not open a pull request; the report is the deliverable.

recipe.title: Morning standup
recipe.description: Summarises yesterday's commits and open review requests.
recipe.prompt: Summarise what landed on main since yesterday morning, then list the pull requests waiting on me.

recipe.title: Draft release notes
recipe.description: Turns the commit range since the last tag into release notes.
recipe.instructions: Group the changes by area and lead with anything that changes behaviour.
recipe.prompt: Draft the release notes for {{ version }} on the {{ channel }} channel.

parameters.description: Which release channel the notes are for.
Post the notes to the team channel when they are ready.

recipe.title: Nightly green build
recipe.description: Runs the full gate and retries the flaky parts before reporting.
recipe.instructions: Run the lint, test and format gates in that order.
recipe.prompt: Run the full gate on {{ branch }} and report what failed.

parameters.description: Branch to run the gate on.
